stories.title: Two skulls likely belonging to enslaved people returned to Brazil after Harvard used them in eugenics studies
bullet_points: Remains believed to have belonged to Africans or Afro-Brazilians repatriated after being flown back by diplomats   Two skulls, including that of a man believed to have taken part in Brazil’s greatest slave revolt but whose remains were taken to the United States and used in racist eugenics studies at Harvard University, were repatriated on Wednesday.
The remains had been outside Brazil since the 19th century.

One was taken about 190 years ago from Salvador, the capital of the state of Bahia; the other, about 160 years ago, from Rio de Janeiro – and were welcomed back in moving, subdued ceremonies in both cities.

stories.title: Ex-member of radical Marxist group scales balcony, escapes house arrest in Argentina
bullet_points: Leonardo Bertulazzi, 74, awaiting extradition to Italy, reportedly used harness to flee custody  A 74-year-old former member of  Italy ’s radical Marxist group the Red Brigades has escaped from house arrest in  Argentina , the country’s security ministry confirmed on Wednesday, after he reportedly hid his ankle monitor inside a tube of pork and lowered himself from a fifth-floor balcony.
Authorities placed Leonardo Bertulazzi under house arrest in Buenos Aires in 2024, prior to his extradition to Italy to serve a 27-year prison sentence.
He had received the sentence in 1987 for joining a subversive association and belonging to an armed group.
